finalists.label: Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis (HLH)
finalists.why: This candidate has the strongest evidence, including bone marrow biopsy suggesting HLH and elevated interleukin (IL)-2R alpha levels.

finalists.label: Lymphoma
finalists.why: This candidate is supported by peritoneal biopsy showing dense atypical lymphoid infiltrate and immunohistochemistry results.

finalists.label: Macrophage activation syndrome
finalists.why: This candidate is supported by bone marrow biopsy suggesting HLH and elevated interleukin (IL)-2R alpha levels, but it is less specific than HLH.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most decisive findings, including bone marrow biopsy suggesting HLH, elevated interleukin (IL)-2R alpha levels, and the patient's symptoms and laboratory results are consistent with HLH.
